goal: list all files in current working directory (cwd)

execute_ls.description: Run the 'ls' command to list all files in the current working directory.
execute_ls.findings_summary: The operation history shows that the 'ls' command was executed successfully in the current working directory. The output lists the following files and directories: .config/, .java/, .local/, .ssh/, and several configuration files (e.g., .bashrc, .profile, .zshrc), along with two additional files: open_ports.txt and traffic.pcap. All entries are explicitly present in the provided execution flow and match verified facts. No discrepancies or missing data were found in the step-by-step logs.
